messages:
Rae: Quick poll  commuter challenge next week? bike-to-work day vs stair-ladder commute (take stairs all the way up). tiny prize: office fruit bowl treat. :apple: :bike:
Hank: Oooh bike day for me. my e-bike needs fresh air.
Marta: stairs for me  doing stairs burns more time than i thought. scalable though  maybe elevator for the heavy bag days.
Juniper: can i alternate? bike in, stairs up home?
Rae: alternates totally valid. main rule: do something extra to commute that day and post a selfie or a snapped route screenshot. honesty rule applies. :camera_with_flash:
Hank: @stretch-bot can we set a reminder and collect RSVPs?
stretch-bot: stretch-bot: Reminder set Mon-Fri 8:30am. Reply in thread with "bike" or "stairs" to RSVP. I'll tally.
Marta: RSVP: stairs (Tue, Thu)
Hank: RSVP: bike (Mon, Wed)
Juniper: RSVP: bike (Mon), stairs (Wed) tentative Thu
Rae: i'll do stairs Wed, and bike Fri (yes, mixed strategy). also suggestion: short post-commute stretch circle at 9:15 next to the pantry for anyone who wants to loosen up. 5 mins.
Marta: love a quick stretch. my calves will thank you.
Hank: prize note: office fruit bowl winner picks first snack on Friday afternoon. winner = most days logged or most creative commute photo.
Juniper: creative photo category: mine will be "sweaty helmet hair, 0 regrets."
Rae: calendar invites incoming. will pin photos in this thread so we can vote Friday. low-stakes and fun. :raised_hands:
Marta: also tiny tip: wear grippy shoes for stairs. learned it the hard way.
Hank: and secure your helmet straps, kids. last week's wobble was a tale.
Juniper: excited. may the best commute win. :trophy:
